[IARC.5.1] libds (this tree) is engine-only C code. The DS
compiler is a separate program, written in Mercury ([IARC.1.6]),
under the top-level `compiler/` tree (see [IARC.9.2]). It runs
as its own process and produces the `.dsc` artefact the engine
loads ([RARC.2.5.1]). Neither tree links the other.
